import json, urllib.request, ssl

ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
prom = "http://10.10.20.30:9090"

def prom_query(expr):
    try:
        url = f"{prom}/api/v1/query?query={urllib.request.quote(expr)}"
        req = urllib.request.Request(url)
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10)
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        return data.get("data", {}).get("result", [])
    except Exception as e:
        return []

# Host health (up metric from node_exporter â€” jobs end in -node)
up_results = prom_query('up{job=~".*-node"}')
hosts_up = sum(1 for r in up_results if r["value"][1] == "1")
hosts_total = len(up_results)

# Blackbox service health (blackbox-http and blackbox-icmp)
svc_results = prom_query('probe_success{job=~"blackbox-.*"}')
svcs_up = sum(1 for r in svc_results if r["value"][1] == "1")
svcs_total = len(svc_results)

# Worst disk usage (all node exporter targets, root mount)
disk_results = prom_query('100 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="tmpfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!="tmpfs"} * 100)')
worst_disk = "N/A"
worst_pct = 0
for r in disk_results:
    pct = float(r["value"][1])
    job = r["metric"].get("job", "unknown")
    host = job.replace("-node", "") if job.endswith("-node") else r["metric"].get("instance", "unknown")
    if pct > worst_pct:
        worst_pct = pct
        worst_disk = f"{host} ({pct:.0f}%)"

section = f"INFRASTRUCTURE\\nHosts: {hosts_up}/{hosts_total} HEALTHY\\nServices: {svcs_up}/{svcs_total} UP\\nDisk Watch: {worst_disk}"
print(json.dumps({"section": section}))

import json, datetime, io

try:
    import paramiko
    key_str = """$haccp_ssh_key"""
    key = paramiko.Ed25519Key.from_private_key(io.StringIO(key_str))
    ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
    ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
    ssh.connect("10.10.30.25", username="bchaplow", pkey=key, timeout=10)
    today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    path = "/opt/elk/briefing/haccp-nightly-" + today + ".json"
    stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command("cat " + path)
    raw = stdout.read().decode()
    ssh.close()
    data = json.loads(raw)
    summary = data.get("summary", "")
    summary = summary.replace(chr(10), " ").replace(chr(13), " ").replace(chr(92), "").replace(chr(34), chr(39)).strip()
    stats = data.get("stats_summary", {})
    total = stats.get("total_events", 0)
    tags = stats.get("tags", [])
    tier1 = next((t[1] for t in tags if t[0] == "tier1_ti_match"), 0)
    tier2 = next((t[1] for t in tags if t[0] == "tier2_novel"), 0)
    if len(summary) > 3900:
        summary = summary[:3900].rsplit(" ", 1)[0] + "..."
    stats_line = "HACCP: " + str(total) + " events, " + str(tier1) + " TI matches, " + str(tier2) + " novel"
    embed = {
        "title": "HACCP Zeek Network (" + today + ")",
        "description": summary,
        "color": 15105570,
        "fields": [
            {"name": "Events", "value": str(total), "inline": True},
            {"name": "TI Matches", "value": str(tier1), "inline": True},
            {"name": "Novel", "value": str(tier2), "inline": True}
        ],
        "footer": {"text": "/opt/elk/briefing/haccp-nightly-" + today + ".json"}
    }
    result = {"stats_line": stats_line, "embed": embed}
except Exception as e:
    today = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    stats_line = "HACCP: briefing unavailable -- " + str(e)[:80]
    embed = {
        "title": "HACCP Zeek Network (" + today + ")",
        "description": "Briefing unavailable: " + str(e)[:200],
        "color": 15158332,
        "footer": {"text": "/opt/elk/briefing/haccp-nightly-" + today + ".json"}
    }
    result = {"stats_line": stats_line, "embed": embed}

print(json.dumps(result))
